proposal_edges.explanation: Hypothesis: breakthroughs demonstrate changes in capability.
The proposal intends earned advancement to invite joy; no reader effect is guaranteed.
Giving others power may expand obligations rather than cancel them.
The paladin's commitments motivate costly heroic decisions.
